Use Case Name: MT103 payment to a first-seen beneficiary account
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; Payment warehouse / back-office; Sanctions & screening engine
Sample Log: 2026-02-11T02:14:07Z saa-prd-01 SAA_MSG_JOURNAL: evt=MSG_CREATED inst=SAA_PROD msg_type=MT103 uetr=7f3b1c22-9d41-4e58-b0a2-6f41a2d9c011 mur=PAY20260211A0417 sender_bic=BANKGB2LXXX receiver_bic=UNKNBKKHXXX f32A=260211USD4875000,00 f50K="/GB29NWBK60161331926819 ACME HOLDINGS LTD" f59="/KH1234567890123 SOKHA TRADING CO" f70="CONSULTING FEE" operator=svc_payhub channel=MQ_HOST_ADAPTER beneficiary_first_seen=true corridor_first_seen=true
Description: Alerts when an outbound MT103 (single customer credit transfer) names a beneficiary account, IBAN or receiver BIC that has never appeared in the institution's historical payment baseline. First-seen beneficiaries combined with high value are the dominant pattern in SWIFT-enabled payment fraud (Bangladesh Bank, NIC Asia, Banco de Chile).

Use Case Name: High-value payment released outside business hours
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access event journal; Alliance Access message journal
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T23:51:40Z saa-prd-01 SAA_EVENT: evt=MSG_AUTHORISED instance=SAA_PROD msg_type=MT202 uetr=11a4c0de-5512-41f7-bd90-99e2b7704f33 amount=USD 81,000,000.00 sender_bic=BANKGB2LXXX receiver_bic=FEDBUS33XXX operator=jsmith_adm operator_profile=PAYMENT_AUTHORISER unit=TREASURY_OPS src_ip=10.44.8.17 local_time=23:51 business_window=07:00-19:00 result=OK
Description: Detects authorisation or release of high-value MT202/MT103 traffic outside the institution's declared payment operating window. Attackers deliberately time injections for weekends, public holidays and end-of-day cut-over so the fraudulent instruction settles before reconciliation runs.

Use Case Name: MT202COV cover payment with no matching underlying MT103
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; Payment warehouse / back-office; Nostro reconciliation system
Sample Log: 2026-02-11T09:03:18Z saa-prd-01 SAA_MSG_JOURNAL: evt=MSG_SENT msg_type=MT202COV uetr=d0c7be41-2240-4c3e-9f8f-7a2e6ad11c90 f20=COV2026021100931 f21=REL-NOTFOUND f32A=260211USD2250000,00 sender_bic=BANKGB2LXXX receiver_bic=CHASUS33XXX seq_B_f50K="/GB11BARC20031855764913 NORTHWIND LTD" underlying_mt103_match=NONE reconciliation_status=ORPHAN_COVER
Description: Correlates every MT202COV cover message against the underlying customer credit transfer it claims to cover. An orphaned cover, or a cover whose Sequence B ordering/beneficiary customer differs from the referenced MT103, indicates message tampering or an injected instruction crafted to move funds without a legitimate underlying trade.

Use Case Name: Message created and authorised by the same operator (four-eyes bypass)
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls; CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control
Log Source: Alliance Access event journal; Alliance Access security audit trail
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T13:22:55Z saa-prd-01 SAA_EVENT: evt=MSG_AUTHORISED instance=SAA_PROD uetr=5c91a0bb-7745-4cd2-a9ee-0dd3cc2e7a41 msg_type=MT103 amount=USD 640,000.00 created_by=mkumar authorised_by=mkumar approval_rule=4EYES_REQUIRED rule_applied=NONE routing_point=RP_AUTH_PAYMENT reason="profile override" result=OK
Description: Flags any payment instruction whose creator and authoriser are the same operator ID, or where a routing rule that mandates dual authorisation was bypassed, disabled or overridden. This is the single control most often disabled by an insider or by an attacker holding administrator rights on Alliance Access.

Use Case Name: Payment message modified after verification
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls; CSCF 6.2 Software Integrity
Log Source: Alliance Access event journal; Alliance Access message journal
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T15:40:02Z saa-prd-01 SAA_EVENT: evt=MSG_MODIFIED instance=SAA_PROD uetr=28ffb741-3a16-4f61-8b51-ec4a94d701c7 msg_type=MT103 prev_state=VERIFIED new_state=MODIFIED field=59 old_value="/DE89370400440532013000 MUELLER GMBH" new_value="/AE070331234567890123456 GULF LINK FZE" operator=ops_admin profile=SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR
Description: Detects edits to the beneficiary, amount or currency of a message that has already passed verification. A state transition from VERIFIED back to a modifiable state is almost never legitimate in a controlled payment flow and is the hallmark of last-mile payment manipulation.

Use Case Name: Structuring — repeated payments just below the authorisation threshold
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; Payment warehouse / back-office
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T10:05:11Z saa-prd-01 SAA_MSG_JOURNAL: evt=MSG_SENT msg_type=MT103 uetr=9a0e6b17-01c3-4b2f-a0d1-55cf0bb8e912 f32A=260213USD999500,00 receiver_bic=HKBCHKHHXXX f59="/HK4412345678901 EASTPOINT LIMITED" operator=tkwan threshold_dual_auth=USD1000000 delta_to_threshold=500.00 seq_in_window=7 window=60m same_beneficiary_count=7 window_total=USD6996500,00
Description: Identifies a burst of payments individually sitting just under the dual-authorisation or senior-approval threshold but aggregating to a material amount, to the same or related beneficiaries, inside a short window.

Use Case Name: Outbound payment volume spike per operator or per BIC corridor
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; SWIFTNet Link traffic statistics
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T18:00:00Z siem-analytics SWIFT_BASELINE: metric=outbound_msg_count operator=rpatel bic_corridor=BANKGB2L>RUSBRUMMXXX window=1h observed=142 baseline_mean=4.2 baseline_stddev=1.8 zscore=76.5 total_value=USD 23,880,000.00 msg_types=MT103,MT202 verdict=ANOMALY
Description: Statistical baselining of message counts and value per operator, per message type and per sender/receiver BIC corridor. Mass-injection fraud produces a volume signature that single-message rules miss.

Use Case Name: Payment to a sanctioned or high-risk jurisdiction
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Sanctions & screening engine; Alliance Access message journal
Sample Log: 2026-02-11T11:12:48Z screening-gw SANCTIONS: evt=SCREEN_RESULT engine=FircoSoft ref=UETR:63d1f0a7-88b2-4c33-97a8-5b6f0a3d9122 msg_type=MT103 hit_type=COUNTRY list=OFAC_SDN match_field=57A match_value=SBERRUMM beneficiary_country=RU score=98 action=RELEASED_BY_OPERATOR operator=aops_02 override_reason="client instruction" queue=HIT_REVIEW
Description: Alerts on payment messages that match sanctions, embargo or high-risk-jurisdiction lists — and, critically, on operator overrides that release a screening hit. The override event is a higher-value detection than the hit itself.

Use Case Name: Duplicate or reused transaction reference (MUR / UETR / field 20)
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; SWIFTNet Link delivery notifications
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T08:31:27Z saa-prd-01 SAA_MSG_JOURNAL: evt=MSG_CREATED msg_type=MT103 f20=INV20260209X7741 mur=PAY20260209A0188 uetr=4b9c21fd-1119-4f6c-bb2f-e0a0b0b9f6d3 duplicate_of_uetr=0ab42e55-2aa7-4b0c-9d6e-f1c4a2217b88 original_sent=2026-02-09T08:29:51Z amount_match=true beneficiary_match=false flag=REFERENCE_REUSE
Description: Detects reuse of a transaction reference with differing payment content — an attacker replaying a legitimate reference so the instruction passes reference-based reconciliation while funds are redirected.

Use Case Name: Missing or suppressed MT940/MT950 account statement
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; Nostro reconciliation system
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T07:00:00Z recon-engine RECON: evt=STATEMENT_MISSING account=NOSTRO-USD-CHASUS33 expected_msg=MT950 expected_by=2026-02-13T06:00:00Z last_received=2026-02-11T06:02:14Z consecutive_missing=2 open_payments_since=USD 94,300,000.00 status=UNRECONCILED
Description: Attackers suppress, delete or divert incoming confirmations and statements to delay discovery of fraudulent debits — the technique used to hide the Bangladesh Bank transfers. A missing statement is an incident, not a housekeeping issue.

Use Case Name: Unexpected MT900/MT910 debit or credit confirmation
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; Nostro reconciliation system
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T04:17:33Z saa-prd-01 SAA_MSG_JOURNAL: evt=MSG_RECEIVED msg_type=MT900 f20=CONF99201 f21=UNKNOWN-REF f32A=260213USD12500000,00 sender_bic=CHASUS33XXX matching_outbound=NONE account=NOSTRO-USD-CHASUS33 flag=UNMATCHED_DEBIT_CONFIRMATION
Description: A debit confirmation with no corresponding outbound instruction in the institution's own records means a payment left the account by a path the bank cannot see — either an out-of-band injection or a suppressed outbound record.

Use Case Name: Unapproved change to message routing rules or templates
Control Reference: CSCF 2.10 Application Hardening; CSCF 6.2 Software Integrity
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Change management system
Sample Log: 2026-02-10T16:48:12Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=CONFIG_CHANGE object=ROUTING_RULE rule_name=RP_AUTH_HIGHVALUE action=MODIFY attribute=approval_required old=TRUE new=FALSE operator=sysadm_svc profile=SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR change_ticket=NONE src_host=jump-swf-02
Description: Monitors creation, modification and deletion of routing points, approval rules and message templates in Alliance Access, correlated against an approved change record. Disabling an approval routing point is a prerequisite for most SWIFT payment fraud.

Use Case Name: FileAct bulk file transfer outside the agreed schedule
Control Reference: CSCF 2.1 Internal Data Flow Security; CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Gateway event log; SWIFTNet Link logs; File transfer (SFTP) logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-15T03:22:09Z sag-prd-01 SAG_EVENT: evt=FILEACT_TRANSFER direction=OUT service=swift.filact!p request_type=pain.001.001.09 filename=BULK_PAY_20260215_0322.xml size=18422113 records=1,204 total_value=EUR 41,200,000.00 requestor_dn=cn=ifile,o=bankgb2l,o=swift schedule_window=NONE sender_ip=10.44.8.61
Description: FileAct moves bulk payment files that never pass through per-message authorisation screens. Transfers outside the agreed batch windows, or with record counts and totals outside baseline, deserve the same scrutiny as a high-value MT202.

Use Case Name: ISO 20022 pacs.008 / pacs.009 structural anomaly
Control Reference: CSCF 2.9 Transaction Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access message journal; Payment warehouse / back-office
Sample Log: 2026-02-16T10:44:51Z saa-prd-01 SAA_MSG_JOURNAL: evt=MSG_VALIDATION msg_type=pacs.008.001.08 uetr=c81f2b36-5f70-4d6e-9c1d-3aa5b2d91f04 IntrBkSttlmAmt=USD3750000.00 Dbtr.Nm="ACME HOLDINGS LTD" DbtrAgt.BICFI=ABSENT CdtrAgt.BICFI=UNKNBKKHXXX RmtInf.Ustrd="" validation=WARN rule=MANDATORY_AGENT_MISSING purpose_code=ABSENT
Description: Validates CBPR+ / ISO 20022 payment messages for missing mandatory agents, empty remittance information, purpose-code stripping and amount/currency mismatches between blocks — signs of a hand-crafted rather than system-generated instruction.

Use Case Name: Message deleted, aborted or purged from the queue
Control Reference: CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access event journal; Alliance Access security audit trail
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T05:02:44Z saa-prd-01 SAA_EVENT: evt=MSG_DELETED instance=SAA_PROD uetr=0f5b9a12-7730-4ce1-8d92-7d1aa8b4e5c0 msg_type=MT900 queue=_SI_to_MQSA state=RECEIVED operator=ops_admin profile=SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR reason="" count_in_window=23 window=10m
Description: Bulk deletion of received confirmations or outbound copies from Alliance Access queues is an anti-forensic step taken to break reconciliation. Any deletion by an administrator profile — especially of inbound confirmation types — should page the on-call team.

Use Case Name: New RMA authorisation granted to a correspondent
Control Reference: CSCF 2.11A RMA Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access RMA audit log; SWIFTNet Link logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-10T17:05:31Z saa-prd-01 RMA_AUDIT: evt=RMA_AUTH_GRANTED local_bic=BANKGB2LXXX correspondent_bic=UNKNBKKHXXX message_types=fin.103,fin.202 valid_from=2026-02-10 valid_to=2099-12-31 granted_by=sysadm_svc approval_ticket=NONE prior_relationship=NONE
Description: An RMA authorisation is the prerequisite for exchanging FIN traffic with a counterparty. A new grant to a BIC with no business relationship, no approval record, or an open-ended validity, directly enables fraudulent outbound payments.

Use Case Name: Bulk revocation or deletion of RMA relationships
Control Reference: CSCF 2.11A RMA Business Controls
Log Source: Alliance Access RMA audit log
Sample Log: 2026-02-10T17:19:02Z saa-prd-01 RMA_AUDIT: evt=RMA_REVOKED local_bic=BANKGB2LXXX correspondent_bic=DEUTDEFFXXX revoked_by=sysadm_svc revocations_in_window=48 window=15m approval_ticket=NONE impact=OUTBOUND_BLOCKED
Description: Mass RMA revocation is both a denial-of-service against legitimate correspondents and a cover action that reduces the set of counterparties able to query or confirm suspect traffic.

Use Case Name: New or changed destination BIC in the routing table
Control Reference: CSCF 2.10 Application Hardening
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Change management system
Sample Log: 2026-02-10T16:52:40Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=CONFIG_CHANGE object=CORRESPONDENT action=ADD bic=UNKNBKKHXXX institution="UNKNOWN BANK PLC, PHNOM PENH" country=KH added_by=sysadm_svc change_ticket=NONE src_host=jump-swf-02 first_payment_within=00:21:27
Description: Correlates additions and edits in the correspondent/BIC routing table with the time to first payment. An unapproved correspondent that receives traffic within minutes of creation is a near-certain fraud indicator.

Use Case Name: New operator created on a SWIFT component
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Alliance Web Platform logs; Identity governance (IGA)
Sample Log: 2026-02-10T16:31:08Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=OPERATOR_CREATED instance=SAA_PROD operator=svc_mt_batch profile=SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR units=ALL created_by=sysadm_svc lau_required=false password_never_expires=true hr_record=NOT_FOUND change_ticket=NONE
Description: Every operator creation on Alliance Access, Alliance Gateway or the Web Platform must map to an approved joiner record. Accounts with no HR match, administrator profiles, or non-expiring credentials are flagged immediately.

Use Case Name: Operator profile escalated to an administrative role
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Privileged access management (PAM)
Sample Log: 2026-02-11T09:47:19Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=OPERATOR_MODIFIED operator=tkwan attribute=profile old_value=PAYMENT_CREATOR new_value=SECURITY_OFFICER modified_by=sysadm_svc approval=NONE lau_admin_granted=true
Description: Escalation to Security Officer, System Administrator or LAU administrator on a SWIFT component grants the ability to disable the controls that stop fraudulent payments. Treat as a privileged-access incident until proven to be an approved change.

Use Case Name: Dormant SWIFT operator account reactivated and used
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control; CSCF 4.1 Password Policy
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Identity governance (IGA)
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T07:12:55Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=OPERATOR_ENABLED operator=dmorris last_login=2025-03-04T11:20:10Z dormant_days=345 enabled_by=sysadm_svc followed_by=LOGIN_OK@2026-02-12T07:14:02Z src_ip=10.44.8.61 password_reset=true
Description: Dormant and leaver accounts are reused because they already hold payment entitlements and attract no attention. Reactivation followed by immediate login — particularly with an administrative password reset — is a strong compromise signal.

Use Case Name: SWIFT operator login from outside the secure zone
Control Reference: CSCF 1.1 SWIFT Environment Protection; CSCF 2.6 Operator Session Confidentiality
Log Source: Alliance Web Platform logs; Jump server / PAM logs; Firewall logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T21:08:33Z swp-prd-01 SWP_AUTH: evt=LOGIN_SUCCESS user=mkumar application=Alliance_Access_GUI src_ip=172.19.44.102 src_zone=CORP_LAN expected_zone=SWIFT_SECURE_ZONE jump_host=NONE mfa=NOT_PRESENTED session_id=SWP-5f20a1
Description: CSCF requires that operator sessions to SWIFT applications originate only from the protected secure zone, via a jump server, with MFA. A session sourced from the general corporate LAN or a VPN pool means the segmentation control has failed or been bypassed.

Use Case Name: Repeated failed authentication against SWIFT interfaces
Control Reference: CSCF 4.1 Password Policy; CSCF 6.5A Intrusion Detection
Log Source: Alliance Web Platform logs; Alliance Access security audit trail; Jump server / PAM logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T20:41:17Z swp-prd-01 SWP_AUTH: evt=LOGIN_FAILURE user=aops_02 reason=BAD_PASSWORD src_ip=10.44.9.230 attempt=11 window=4m distinct_users_from_ip=6 result=ACCOUNT_LOCKED
Description: Brute-force and password-spraying against the Alliance Web Platform or Alliance Access login. Count both per-account attempts and distinct accounts targeted from one source, which distinguishes spraying from a forgotten password.

Use Case Name: Multi-factor authentication not enforced for a SWIFT session
Control Reference: CSCF 4.2 Multi-Factor Authentication
Log Source: Alliance Web Platform logs; MFA / token service logs; Jump server / PAM logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T21:09:04Z mfa-gw MFA_AUDIT: evt=AUTH_BYPASS user=mkumar target_app=Alliance_Web_Platform policy=SWIFT_MFA_REQUIRED enforcement=DISABLED changed_by=iam_admin changed_at=2026-02-12T20:55:41Z src_ip=172.19.44.102 session_granted=true
Description: Detects both MFA policy exemptions applied to SWIFT operators and successful sessions where no second factor was presented. CSCF 4.2 makes MFA mandatory for all interactive access to the SWIFT infrastructure.

Use Case Name: Shared, generic or service account used interactively
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Windows/Linux host logs; Jump server / PAM logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T02:35:21Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=LOGIN_SUCCESS operator=svc_payhub account_type=SERVICE interactive=true src_ip=10.44.8.61 expected_usage=API_ONLY distinct_src_ip_24h=4 session_type=GUI
Description: Service and generic accounts must not be used for interactive sessions — doing so destroys attribution. Alert when an account classified as non-interactive opens a GUI or shell session, or when one account ID appears from several workstations.

Use Case Name: Break-glass / emergency account activated
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control; CSCF 5.4 Password Repository Protection
Log Source: Privileged access management (PAM); Alliance Access security audit trail
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T22:58:12Z pam-prd CYBERARK: evt=PASSWORD_RETRIEVED safe=SWIFT_BREAKGLASS account=swift_emergency_adm requested_by=rpatel reason="" dual_control=NOT_REQUESTED incident_ref=NONE target=saa-prd-01 ttl=8h
Description: Checkout of a break-glass credential for the SWIFT estate should be rare, dual-controlled and tied to an incident reference. A checkout with no incident ref or outside an active major incident is investigated within the hour.

Use Case Name: Leaver's SWIFT entitlement not revoked within SLA
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control; CSCF 5.3A Staff Screening
Log Source: Identity governance (IGA); HR system feed; Alliance Access security audit trail
Sample Log: 2026-02-16T06:00:00Z iga-recon IGA: evt=ORPHAN_ENTITLEMENT system=ALLIANCE_ACCESS operator=lwhite hr_status=TERMINATED termination_date=2026-01-28 revocation_sla_days=1 days_overdue=18 profile=PAYMENT_AUTHORISER account_state=ENABLED last_login=2026-02-14T16:22:03Z
Description: Reconciles the SWIFT operator inventory against the HR leaver feed. An enabled payment-authoriser account belonging to a terminated employee — especially one that has logged in since termination — is a critical finding.

Use Case Name: Password policy weakened on a SWIFT component
Control Reference: CSCF 4.1 Password Policy
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Windows/Linux host logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-11T15:02:47Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGE object=PASSWORD_POLICY attribute=min_length old=12 new=6 attribute2=history old2=12 new2=0 attribute3=max_age_days old3=90 new3=0 changed_by=sysadm_svc change_ticket=NONE
Description: Downgrades to password length, complexity, history or expiry on a SWIFT component precede credential-based attacks and breach CSCF 4.1. Compare every policy write against the approved hardening baseline.

Use Case Name: Unapproved outbound internet connection from the secure zone
Control Reference: CSCF 1.4 Restriction of Internet Access; CSCF 1.1 SWIFT Environment Protection
Log Source: Firewall logs; Proxy logs; EDR network telemetry
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:44:02Z fw-swift-01 %ASA-6-302013: Built outbound TCP connection 7781243 for outside:185.212.44.19/443 (185.212.44.19/443) to swift-zone:10.44.8.17/51822 (10.44.8.17/51822) policy=SWIFT_ZONE_EGRESS action=PERMIT_SHADOW_RULE rule_added=2026-02-12T18:10:44Z geo=RU
Description: The SWIFT secure zone must have no direct internet access. Any egress session — especially to a newly permitted destination, an unusual port or a high-risk geography — indicates either a firewall misconfiguration or active command-and-control.

Use Case Name: Firewall rule change exposing the SWIFT secure zone
Control Reference: CSCF 1.1 SWIFT Environment Protection; CSCF 2.3 System Hardening
Log Source: Firewall logs; Network change management; Firewall management console
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T18:10:44Z fw-swift-01 %ASA-5-111008: User 'netops_jm' executed the 'access-list SWIFT_ZONE_IN extended permit ip any object-group SWIFT_HOSTS' command. src=10.9.3.44 change_ticket=NONE scope=ANY_TO_SWIFT_ZONE prior_rule_count=38 new_rule_count=39
Description: Detects any-to-zone, any-service or broad-subnet rules added to the SWIFT perimeter, and any rule change without an approved network change record.

Use Case Name: Direct access to a SWIFT host bypassing the jump server
Control Reference: CSCF 1.1 SWIFT Environment Protection; CSCF 2.6 Operator Session Confidentiality
Log Source: Windows/Linux host logs; Jump server / PAM logs; Firewall logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T00:12:55Z saa-prd-01 sshd[41122]: Accepted publickey for root from 172.19.44.102 port 50122 ssh2: RSA SHA256:9fQ2... src_zone=CORP_LAN jump_host_session=NONE pam_session_id=NONE expected_path=jump-swf-01|jump-swf-02
Description: All administrative access to SWIFT hosts must traverse a recorded, MFA-protected jump server. A session whose source is not a jump host, or which has no corresponding PAM session, means the access path control has been circumvented.

Use Case Name: Remote access or remote control tool present on a SWIFT host
Control Reference: CSCF 2.3 System Hardening; CSCF 6.2 Software Integrity
Log Source: EDR / endpoint telemetry; Windows/Linux host logs; Proxy logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:38:19Z saa-prd-01 EDR: evt=PROCESS_START host=saa-prd-01 zone=SWIFT_SECURE process="C:\Users\svc_payhub\AppData\Local\Temp\aa_v3.exe" sha256=4b1e9c0d77aa31f2e0b5cc9a2d41f7703e8d0b6cc2b1a9f45d0e77a1c3b22e90 parent=powershell.exe classification=REMOTE_ACCESS_TOOL signature="AnyDesk (unsigned repack)" net_conn=185.212.44.19:443
Description: Installation or execution of RDP relays, AnyDesk, TeamViewer, VNC, ngrok or reverse-shell tooling inside the secure zone. The SWIFT application estate has a tightly defined software inventory, so allow-listing makes this a high-fidelity detection.

Use Case Name: Unauthorised software or unsigned binary executed in the secure zone
Control Reference: CSCF 2.3 System Hardening; CSCF 6.2 Software Integrity
Log Source: EDR / endpoint telemetry; Application allow-listing logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:36:02Z saa-prd-01 APPCTRL: evt=EXEC_BLOCKED_AUDIT_ONLY policy=SWIFT_ALLOWLIST file="D:\Temp\evtdiag.exe" sha256=0d8f61bb2a44ce1980f3a0c7d1e2449f7b6c3e5a22d9108c4f4b0dd7e1a9c233 signer=UNSIGNED user=svc_payhub parent=cmd.exe decision=ALLOWED_BY_EXCEPTION exception_added_by=sysadm_svc
Description: Application allow-listing on SWIFT hosts should be in enforce mode. Alert on executions permitted only by a new exception, on unsigned binaries, and on any allow-list policy downgrade.

Use Case Name: File integrity change on SWIFT application binaries or configuration
Control Reference: CSCF 6.2 Software Integrity; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: File integrity monitoring (FIM); EDR / endpoint telemetry
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:41:30Z saa-prd-01 FIM: evt=FILE_MODIFIED path="C:\Program Files\SWIFT Alliance Access\bin\saa_rtm.dll" old_sha256=a91f...3cd2 new_sha256=77b0...9e41 size_delta=+40960 signer_before="S.W.I.F.T. SC" signer_after=UNSIGNED user=SYSTEM process=rundll32.exe change_ticket=NONE baseline=SWIFT_GOLD_IMAGE
Description: The Alliance Access/Gateway binaries, the database client libraries and the local message-validation components are the exact artefacts tampered with in documented SWIFT intrusions. Any hash change outside a vendor patch window is a critical incident.

Use Case Name: Direct database access to the Alliance Access message store
Control Reference: CSCF 6.3 Database Integrity; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Database audit logs (Oracle/DB2); Database activity monitoring (DAM)
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T02:05:41Z dbsrv-swf-01 ORA_AUDIT: SESSIONID=99102 DB_USER=SAAOWNER OS_USER=svc_payhub CLIENT_HOST=saa-prd-01 CLIENT_PROGRAM=sqlplus.exe ACTION=UPDATE OBJ_NAME=SAA.MESSAGE_INSTANCE SQL="UPDATE SAA.MESSAGE_INSTANCE SET STATE='COMPLETED' WHERE UETR IN (...)" ROWS=23 PRIV_USED=UPDATE_ANY_TABLE TIMESTAMP=2026-02-13T02:05:41Z
Description: Alliance Access data must be changed through the application, never by direct SQL. DML against message, operator or audit tables by sqlplus, DBeaver or a script is manipulation of the payment record itself.

Use Case Name: Export, dump or backup of the SWIFT message database

Log Source: Database audit logs (Oracle/DB2); EDR / endpoint telemetry; Backup system logs

Description: Unscheduled exports of the SWIFT schema copy every historical payment, counterparty and operator record out of the protected zone. Correlate the export with any subsequent movement of the dump file.

Use Case Name: Audit logging disabled or event journal cleared on a SWIFT component
Control Reference: CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Windows/Linux host logs; SIEM collector health

Description: Clearing the Windows Security log, truncating the Alliance Access event journal, or disabling the audit subsystem is anti-forensic activity. Pair with a collector-health rule so loss of the log source itself raises the same alert.

Use Case Name: SWIFT log source stopped sending events
Control Reference: CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: SIEM collector health; Alliance Access event journal; Alliance Gateway event log

Description: A silent SWIFT log source is treated as a potential compromise, not an outage. Every component in the secure zone has an expected events-per-second floor and an alert when it is not met.

Use Case Name: HSM tamper, removal or unexpected PED authentication
Control Reference: CSCF 5.2 Token Management; CSCF 3.1 Physical Security
Log Source: HSM audit logs; Alliance Gateway event log; Physical access control system

Description: The HSM holds the keys that sign SWIFTNet traffic. Security-officer authentications, partition changes, firmware updates and tamper events must map to an approved maintenance window and a dual-control ceremony.

Use Case Name: SWIFTNet PKI certificate created, renewed or revoked
Control Reference: CSCF 5.2 Token Management; CSCF 2.1 Internal Data Flow Security
Log Source: SWIFTNet Link logs; Alliance Gateway event log; HSM audit logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T03:18:49Z snl-prd-01 SNL_PKI: evt=CERT_RECOVERED dn="cn=swiftnet_oper,o=bankgb2l,o=swift" cert_serial=0x5f1a9b22 operation=RECOVERY initiator=svc_payhub lsu_token=SOFT_HSM dual_control=NO approval_ref=NONE valid_to=2028-02-14
Description: SWIFTNet PKI operations — certificate creation, recovery, re-issuance and revocation — control who can authenticate to the SWIFT network as the institution. All should be dual-controlled and scheduled.

Use Case Name: Local Authentication (LAU) key changed or LAU disabled
Control Reference: CSCF 2.1 Internal Data Flow Security; CSCF 2.4A Back Office Data Flow Security
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Alliance Gateway event log
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T03:25:13Z sag-prd-01 SAG_AUDIT: evt=LAU_CONFIG_CHANGE connection=SAA_PROD<->SAG_PROD attribute=lau_enabled old=TRUE new=FALSE changed_by=sysadm_svc dual_control=NO change_ticket=NONE effect=MESSAGE_INTEGRITY_UNPROTECTED
Description: LAU protects the integrity of message flows between the back office, Alliance Access and Alliance Gateway. Disabling it, or rotating the key outside a controlled ceremony, allows an attacker to inject or alter messages on the internal link.

Use Case Name: Anti-malware disabled or not reporting on a SWIFT host
Control Reference: CSCF 6.1 Malware Protection
Log Source: EDR / endpoint telemetry; Anti-malware management console
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:33:11Z epp-console DEFENDER: evt=PROTECTION_DISABLED host=saa-prd-01 zone=SWIFT_SECURE component=RealTimeProtection changed_by=SWFZONE\svc_payhub method=Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true signature_age_days=0 reboot_pending=false
Description: Tampering with endpoint protection on an Alliance Access, Alliance Gateway or jump host precedes tool deployment. Also alert on signature age, agent uninstall and exclusion-path additions covering SWIFT directories.

Use Case Name: Malware or suspicious script detected inside the secure zone
Control Reference: CSCF 6.1 Malware Protection; CSCF 6.5A Intrusion Detection
Log Source: EDR / endpoint telemetry; Anti-malware management console
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:35:44Z epp-console DEFENDER: evt=THREAT_DETECTED host=jump-swf-02 zone=SWIFT_SECURE threat="Trojan:Win32/Mimikatz.A" path="C:\Windows\Temp\m.exe" sha256=61ac...0d9e action=QUARANTINE_FAILED user=SWFZONE\sysadm_svc severity=Severe
Description: Any malware detection on a host in the SWIFT secure zone is a P1 regardless of family, because the zone's software inventory is small and fully controlled. Failed remediation escalates immediately.

Use Case Name: Removable media attached to a SWIFT host
Control Reference: CSCF 2.3 System Hardening; CSCF 3.1 Physical Security
Log Source: EDR / endpoint telemetry; Windows/Linux host logs; DLP agent logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T04:02:31Z saa-prd-01 WinEventLog:System EventCode=20001 Message="Driver Management concluded the process to install driver for device USBSTOR\Disk&Ven_SanDisk&Prod_Ultra" host=saa-prd-01 zone=SWIFT_SECURE user=SWFZONE\sysadm_svc serial=4C530001120present policy=USB_BLOCK_SWIFT result=ALLOWED_BY_EXCEPTION
Description: Removable media is the classic bridge across an air-gapped or segmented payment zone, in both directions — tool import and data exfiltration. Media policy on SWIFT assets should be block-by-default with alerting on every exception.

Use Case Name: Missing security patch on a SWIFT component beyond SLA
Control Reference: CSCF 2.2 Security Updates; CSCF 2.7 Vulnerability Scanning
Log Source: Vulnerability scanner; Patch management system; Asset inventory
Sample Log: 2026-02-16T05:00:00Z vm-console TENABLE: evt=VULN_OPEN asset=sag-prd-01 zone=SWIFT_SECURE plugin_id=188911 cve=CVE-2025-41773 cvss=9.8 severity=Critical first_detected=2025-12-18 days_open=60 sla_days=30 patch_available=true exception=NONE
Description: CSCF 2.2 requires timely application of security updates to all components in scope. Track critical and high findings against the remediation SLA and escalate overdue items on SWIFT-tagged assets.

Use Case Name: Hypervisor or cloud-platform administrative action on a SWIFT VM
Control Reference: CSCF 1.3 Virtualisation or Cloud Platform Protection
Log Source: Hypervisor / vCenter audit logs; Cloud control-plane logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-14T03:52:08Z vcenter-01 VPXD: evt=VirtualMachine.CloneVM user=VSPHERE.LOCAL\vmadmin_ok vm=saa-prd-01 zone=SWIFT_SECURE target_folder="/DC2/Staging" target_datastore=DS_GENERAL_01 snapshot_taken=true change_ticket=NONE
Description: Cloning, snapshotting, migrating or attaching a console to a SWIFT virtual machine gives access to its memory and disk outside the zone's controls. CSCF 1.3 puts the virtualisation layer explicitly in scope.

Use Case Name: Time synchronisation failure or clock change on a SWIFT host
Control Reference: CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring; CSCF 2.3 System Hardening
Log Source: Windows/Linux host logs; NTP service logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T02:50:12Z saa-prd-01 WinEventLog:System EventCode=1 Source=Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-General Message="The system time has changed to 2026-02-13T01:10:12Z from 2026-02-13T02:50:12Z." ChangeReason=ManualChange SubjectUserName=svc_payhub ntp_peer=UNREACHABLE offset_seconds=-6000
Description: Accurate, synchronised time is required for message sequencing, cut-off enforcement and forensic reconstruction. Manual clock changes are also used to move events outside the window an analyst is reviewing.

Use Case Name: SWIFT application service stopped or restarted unexpectedly
Control Reference: CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring; CSCF 7.1 Cyber Incident Response Planning
Log Source: Windows/Linux host logs; Alliance Access event journal; Monitoring platform
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T02:48:20Z saa-prd-01 WinEventLog:System EventCode=7036 Service="SWIFT Alliance Access" NewState=Stopped initiated_by=SWFZONE\svc_payhub method=sc.exe maintenance_window=NONE downtime_seconds=612 queued_messages_at_stop=38
Description: An unplanned stop of Alliance Access, Alliance Gateway or SWIFTNet Link may be a denial of service, a cover for configuration change, or the restart needed to load tampered binaries.

Use Case Name: Message queue backlog or processing halted
Control Reference: CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Alliance Access event journal; MQ / middleware logs; Monitoring platform
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T03:05:00Z saa-prd-01 SAA_EVENT: evt=QUEUE_THRESHOLD queue=_SI_to_SWIFTNet depth=4821 threshold=500 oldest_message_age_min=137 state=HELD held_by=ops_admin reason="" sla_breach=true
Description: Queues deliberately placed on hold stop confirmations and statements from reaching reconciliation while fraudulent instructions continue to flow. Depth, age and manual hold state are all monitored.

Use Case Name: Alliance Access operational mode or instance parameter changed
Control Reference: CSCF 2.10 Application Hardening
Log Source: Alliance Access security audit trail; Change management system
Sample Log: 2026-02-10T16:55:19Z saa-prd-01 SAA_AUDIT: evt=SYSTEM_PARAM_CHANGE instance=SAA_PROD parameter=message_archival_enabled old=TRUE new=FALSE parameter2=event_journal_retention_days old2=400 new2=7 changed_by=sysadm_svc change_ticket=NONE
Description: Instance-level parameters govern archival, retention, duplicate checking and validation strictness. Reducing retention or disabling archival directly reduces the evidence available after a fraudulent payment.

Use Case Name: Privileged session recording disabled for a SWIFT asset
Control Reference: CSCF 5.1 Logical Access Control; CSCF 6.4 Logging and Monitoring
Log Source: Privileged access management (PAM)
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T17:58:33Z pam-prd CYBERARK: evt=PLATFORM_POLICY_CHANGE platform=WIN_SWIFT_SECURE attribute=SessionRecording old=Yes new=No changed_by=pam_admin_rk targets=12 includes=saa-prd-01,sag-prd-01,jump-swf-01 change_ticket=NONE
Description: Keystroke and video recording of privileged sessions on SWIFT hosts is the main after-the-fact control. Disabling it for the SWIFT platform group, or excluding specific assets, is an immediate escalation.

Use Case Name: Unusual data egress volume from the SWIFT secure zone
Control Reference: CSCF 1.4 Restriction of Internet Access; CSCF 2.5A External Transmission Data Protection
Log Source: Firewall logs; NetFlow / network telemetry; Proxy logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T02:30:00Z netflow-col FLOW: src_ip=10.44.8.17 src_zone=SWIFT_SECURE dst_ip=10.9.3.44 dst_zone=CORP_LAN proto=TCP dst_port=445 bytes_out=4,912,004,096 duration_s=1380 baseline_bytes_out_1h=18,220,000 ratio=269x flow_count=6
Description: Volumetric egress from the secure zone to any destination — including internal corporate segments — is anomalous because the zone's legitimate flows are few, well-known and small. Baseline per source host and per destination zone.

Use Case Name: Reconnaissance or lateral-movement activity targeting SWIFT hosts
Control Reference: CSCF 6.5A Intrusion Detection; CSCF 2.7 Vulnerability Scanning
Log Source: IDS/IPS; NetFlow / network telemetry; Windows/Linux host logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T19:22:41Z ids-swf-01 SNORT: [1:2027865:3] ET SCAN Behavioral Unusual Port 445 traffic Potential Scan or Infection [Classification: Misc Activity] {TCP} 10.9.3.44:49722 -> 10.44.8.0/24 unique_dst=61 window=90s dst_zone=SWIFT_SECURE action=ALERT_ONLY
Description: Horizontal scanning, SMB enumeration, Kerberoasting and remote service creation aimed at the SWIFT subnet from the corporate network — the standard path from an initial foothold to the payment estate.

Use Case Name: Operator session hijack indicators — impossible travel or concurrent sessions
Control Reference: CSCF 2.6 Operator Session Confidentiality; CSCF 4.2 Multi-Factor Authentication
Log Source: Alliance Web Platform logs; Jump server / PAM logs; VPN / remote access logs
Sample Log: 2026-02-12T21:14:50Z swp-prd-01 SWP_AUTH: evt=CONCURRENT_SESSION user=mkumar session_a={id:SWP-5f20a1,src_ip:10.44.8.61,start:2026-02-12T20:58:11Z} session_b={id:SWP-5f20c9,src_ip:172.19.44.102,start:2026-02-12T21:14:50Z} distance_km=412 elapsed_min=16 verdict=IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL
Description: Two live sessions for one SWIFT operator, or logins from geographically impossible locations, indicate credential sharing or a stolen session token.

Use Case Name: Change to SWIFT-related scheduled task, cron job or service account rights
Control Reference: CSCF 2.3 System Hardening; CSCF 1.2 OS Privileged Account Control
Log Source: Windows/Linux host logs; EDR / endpoint telemetry
Sample Log: 2026-02-13T01:30:08Z saa-prd-01 WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4698 TaskName="\SWIFT\MsgExportNightly" SubjectUserName=svc_payhub TaskContent="<Exec><Command>powershell.exe</Command><Arguments>-enc SQBuAHYAbwBrAGUA...</Arguments></Exec>" RunLevel=HighestAvailable Trigger=Daily@02:30
Description: Persistence on SWIFT hosts is commonly established through scheduled tasks, services and cron entries running encoded PowerShell or shell payloads under a service identity.

Use Case Name: Firewall rule permitting untrusted inbound traffic into the CDE
Control Reference: PCI DSS 1.2.1; PCI DSS 1.3.1; PCI DSS 1.4.2
Log Source: Firewall logs; Firewall management console; Network change management
Sample Log: 2026-03-04T14:22:09Z fw-cde-01 %ASA-5-111008: User 'netops_ab' executed the 'access-list CDE_IN extended permit tcp any object-group CDE_DB_SERVERS eq 1433' command. src=10.9.3.80 change_ticket=NONE zone_from=UNTRUSTED zone_to=CDE service=MSSQL review_cycle_due=2026-04-01
Description: Detects inbound rules from untrusted networks to the cardholder data environment, any-source or any-service rules, and rules added without an approved change record. Requirement 1 limits CDE ingress to explicitly justified, documented traffic.

Use Case Name: Direct inbound internet connection to a CDE system
Control Reference: PCI DSS 1.3.1; PCI DSS 1.4.4
Log Source: Firewall logs; NetFlow / network telemetry; Cloud control-plane logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-05T02:41:18Z fw-cde-01 %ASA-6-302013: Built inbound TCP connection 9910233 for outside:103.21.88.14/55012 to cde:10.70.12.40/3389 (10.70.12.40/3389) policy=CDE_IN action=PERMIT geo=HK asset_tag=CDE_DB_PRIMARY dmz_traversed=false
Description: No system component storing cardholder data may be directly reachable from the internet. Alert on any flow where an internet source terminates on a CDE-tagged asset without passing the DMZ.

Use Case Name: Outbound connection from the CDE to an untrusted destination
Control Reference: PCI DSS 1.3.2; PCI DSS 1.4.3
Log Source: Firewall logs; Proxy logs; DNS logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-05T02:46:52Z proxy-cde SQUID: 1772678812.441 304 10.70.12.40 TCP_TUNNEL/200 1842991 CONNECT 45.133.1.77:443 - HIER_DIRECT/45.133.1.77 - cat=UNCATEGORISED asset_tag=CDE_APP_01 policy=CDE_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST action=ALLOWED_BY_EXCEPTION
Description: CDE egress must be explicitly allow-listed. Connections to uncategorised domains, newly registered domains, cloud storage or raw IPs are both a Requirement 1 violation and a likely exfiltration path for account data.

Use Case Name: Network segmentation violation — non-CDE host reaching the CDE
Control Reference: PCI DSS 1.2.1; PCI DSS 11.4.5
Log Source: NetFlow / network telemetry; Firewall logs; Asset inventory
Sample Log: 2026-03-06T11:08:14Z netflow-col FLOW: src_ip=10.21.55.118 src_zone=CORP_WORKSTATIONS dst_ip=10.70.12.55 dst_zone=CDE proto=TCP dst_port=1433 bytes=18,220,114 packets=14,902 segmentation_policy=DENY_CORP_TO_CDE observed_action=PERMITTED rule=shadow_any_any_tmp
Description: Segmentation is what keeps the PCI scope small. Any successful session from an out-of-scope segment into the CDE both expands scope and signals a control failure that the annual segmentation test would otherwise catch months later.

Use Case Name: Unauthorised or rogue device on a CDE network segment
Control Reference: PCI DSS 1.2.1; PCI DSS 11.2.1; PCI DSS 12.5.1
Log Source: NAC logs; DHCP logs; Switch / network access logs; Asset inventory
Sample Log: 2026-03-06T09:14:02Z nac-prd CLEARPASS: evt=ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN mac=3C:22:FB:91:0A:7E ip=10.70.12.201 switch=sw-cde-03 port=Gi1/0/22 vlan=CDE_170 auth_method=MAB device_profile=UNKNOWN asset_inventory_match=NONE action=ALLOWED_FALLBACK_VLAN
Description: Devices appearing on a CDE VLAN that are absent from the authorised asset inventory — including unapproved laptops, network taps and consumer hardware.

Use Case Name: Unauthorised wireless access point detected in or near the CDE
Control Reference: PCI DSS 11.2.1; PCI DSS 11.2.2; PCI DSS 1.3.3
Log Source: Wireless IDS (WIPS); NAC logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-07T13:40:55Z wips-01 AIRWAVE: evt=ROGUE_AP_DETECTED bssid=F0:9F:C2:1B:44:90 ssid="hp-setup" channel=6 rssi=-42dBm nearest_sensor=DC1-FLOOR2-CDE classification=ROGUE_ON_WIRE wired_trace=sw-cde-03/Gi1/0/19 encryption=OPEN duration_min=38
Description: Requirement 11.2 mandates quarterly detection of unauthorised wireless. Continuous WIPS monitoring turns that point-in-time test into a detection, especially for rogue APs that are bridged onto the CDE wire.

Use Case Name: Vendor default account or password used on a CDE system
Control Reference: PCI DSS 2.2.2; PCI DSS 8.3.1
Log Source: Windows/Linux host logs; Database audit logs; Network device logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-04T08:12:31Z pos-ctrl-02 sshd[8871]: Accepted password for admin from 10.70.14.22 port 44102 ssh2 account_class=VENDOR_DEFAULT default_credential_match=true asset_tag=CDE_POS_CONTROLLER baseline=CIS_L1 finding=2.2.2_DEFAULT_CREDENTIAL
Description: Vendor default accounts and passwords remain a leading cause of card-data breaches at merchant and processor tier. Detect both successful authentication with known defaults and the continued presence of default accounts in the directory.

Use Case Name: Insecure or unnecessary service enabled on a CDE system
Control Reference: PCI DSS 2.2.4; PCI DSS 2.2.5
Log Source: Vulnerability scanner; Configuration management (CMDB/SCM); Windows/Linux host logs

Description: Clear-text protocols and unnecessary daemons inside the CDE both weaken the environment and expose authentication data in transit. Detect from configuration scans and from live listening-port telemetry.

Use Case Name: Configuration drift from the hardened baseline on a CDE asset
Control Reference: PCI DSS 2.2.1; PCI DSS 11.5.2
Log Source: Configuration management (CMDB/SCM); File integrity monitoring (FIM)
Sample Log: 2026-03-08T04:05:12Z scm-prd CHEF_AUDIT: evt=DRIFT_DETECTED node=cde-web-03 asset_tag=CDE profile=pci-hardening-v7 controls_failed=4 details="sshd PermitRootLogin yes; auditd stopped; firewalld disabled; umask 0022" last_compliant=2026-03-01T04:05:00Z changed_by=root@cde-web-03
Description: Baseline drift on in-scope systems is both a compliance finding and an early indicator that someone has been configuring the host by hand outside change control.

Use Case Name: Change deployed to a CDE system outside the approved change window
Control Reference: PCI DSS 6.5.1; PCI DSS 2.2.1
Log Source: Change management system; Windows/Linux host logs; CI/CD pipeline logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-09T23:41:07Z cicd-prd JENKINS: evt=DEPLOY_SUCCESS job=payment-api-prod build=1182 target=cde-app-07 artifact=payment-api-4.2.1.jar triggered_by=dchen approval=NONE change_window=SUN0200-0500 deployed_at=MON2341 cab_ref=NONE
Description: Correlates deployments and configuration writes on CDE assets against approved change records and windows, catching both unauthorised releases and emergency changes that were never retro-documented.

Use Case Name: Primary account number found in clear text in logs or files
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.3.1; PCI DSS 3.5.1
Log Source: DLP agent logs; Application logs; File integrity monitoring (FIM)
Sample Log: 2026-03-05T16:20:44Z dlp-prd SYMANTEC_DLP: evt=POLICY_VIOLATION policy="PCI - PAN in clear text" host=cde-app-07 path="/var/log/payment-api/debug-2026-03-05.log" matches=1,412 sample="4539****... (Luhn valid, BIN 453912)" classification=PAN_CLEARTEXT severity=Critical action=INCIDENT_CREATED
Description: Debug logging, stack traces, temp files and support exports are the most common places unmasked PANs escape the protected store. Scan log paths and shares continuously, not only during the annual assessment.

Use Case Name: Sensitive authentication data retained after authorisation
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.3.1; PCI DSS 3.3.2; PCI DSS 3.3.3
Log Source: DLP agent logs; Database activity monitoring (DAM); Application logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-05T16:23:02Z dlp-prd SYMANTEC_DLP: evt=POLICY_VIOLATION policy="PCI - SAD after authorisation" host=cde-db-01 object=PAYMENTS.TXN_AUTH_RAW columns=TRACK2_DATA,CVV2 rows_with_data=88,214 oldest_record=2025-11-02 auth_completed=true severity=Critical
Description: Track data, CVV2/CVC2 and PIN blocks must never be stored after authorisation — not even encrypted. Detect via content scanning of databases, files and message queues inside the CDE.

Use Case Name: Bulk read or export of cardholder data
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.4.1; PCI DSS 7.2.1; PCI DSS 10.2.1.1
Log Source: Database activity monitoring (DAM); Database audit logs; Application logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-06T02:14:38Z dam-prd IMPERVA: evt=EXCESSIVE_RECORD_ACCESS db=PAYMENTS schema=CARDHOLDER object=CARD_VAULT db_user=app_payments os_user=svc_report client_host=10.70.12.90 sql="SELECT pan_token, pan_enc, exp_date, cardholder_name FROM CARDHOLDER.CARD_VAULT" rows_returned=2,104,773 baseline_p99_rows=250 duration_s=94
Description: Row-count baselining on cardholder tables catches the moment legitimate credentials are used for mass extraction, which per-query access control cannot see.

Use Case Name: Detokenisation or decryption request volume spike
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.5.1; PCI DSS 3.6.1; PCI DSS 7.2.1
Log Source: Tokenisation vault logs; HSM audit logs; Application logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-06T02:22:10Z tokenvault-01 TVAULT: evt=DETOKENIZE_BATCH caller=svc_report caller_ip=10.70.12.90 tokens_requested=184,221 window_s=300 baseline_per_5m=120 ratio=1535x purpose_code=NOT_SUPPLIED result=SUCCESS keyset=PRD_PAN_KEK_2025
Description: The tokenisation vault and the cryptographic service are the choke points where protected data becomes readable. Rate, caller and purpose-code anomalies there are the highest-value cardholder-data detections available.

Use Case Name: Cryptographic key management operation on CDE keys
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.6.1; PCI DSS 3.7.1; PCI DSS 3.7.4
Log Source: HSM audit logs; Key management system (KMS) logs; Cloud control-plane logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-07T10:04:55Z kms-prd AWS_CLOUDTRAIL: eventName=ScheduleKeyDeletion userIdentity.arn=arn:aws:iam::4411:user/svc_deploy keyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:4411:key/9c2f-...-7ab1 keyAlias=alias/pci-pan-dek pendingWindowInDays=7 sourceIPAddress=10.70.12.90 dualControl=false mfaAuthenticated=false
Description: Key creation, rotation, export, disablement and deletion for keys protecting account data must be dual-controlled and logged. Deletion scheduling or export of a data-encryption key is an emergency-grade event.

Use Case Name: Cardholder data retained beyond the defined retention period
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.2.1; PCI DSS 3.1.1
Log Source: Database activity monitoring (DAM); Data discovery scan results; Application logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-08T05:00:00Z data-gov COLLIBRA: evt=RETENTION_BREACH store=PAYMENTS.CARDHOLDER.CARD_VAULT policy=PCI_RETENTION_13M records_over_policy=412,908 oldest_record=2022-07-14 purge_job=pci_purge_monthly last_successful_run=2025-10-31 status=FAILED_SINCE
Description: Requirement 3.2 limits storage to what is necessary for business, legal or regulatory purposes. A failed or disabled purge job silently grows both the breach surface and the assessment finding.

Use Case Name: Cardholder data discovered outside the defined CDE
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.2.1; PCI DSS 12.5.2
Log Source: Data discovery scan results; DLP agent logs; Cloud storage audit logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-08T06:12:49Z discovery-prd BIGID: evt=PAN_FOUND_OUT_OF_SCOPE location="s3://corp-analytics-export/adhoc/2026-02/txn_dump.csv" account=4411-ANALYTICS scope_tag=NON_CDE pan_count=93,441 luhn_valid=true encryption=SSE-S3 public_access=false owner=analytics_team
Description: Account data found on file shares, analytics lakes, ticketing systems or developer laptops drags those systems into PCI scope and usually means a control-free copy of the card portfolio exists.

Use Case Name: Cardholder data transmitted over an unencrypted channel
Control Reference: PCI DSS 4.2.1
Log Source: IDS/IPS; NetFlow / network telemetry; Proxy logs; DLP network sensor
Sample Log: 2026-03-05T12:33:02Z ids-cde-01 SURICATA: [1:2045511:2] PCI PAN observed in cleartext HTTP body [Classification: Policy Violation] {TCP} 10.70.12.40:49881 -> 198.51.100.23:80 http.method=POST http.uri=/api/v1/settle pan_matches=37 tls=NONE action=ALERT
Description: PAN transmitted over HTTP, unencrypted SMTP, FTP or an internal link without TLS. Network content inspection at the CDE boundary is the only reliable way to see this.

Use Case Name: Weak TLS version or cipher negotiated to a CDE endpoint

Use Case Name: Segmentation penetration test control failure
Control Reference: PCI DSS 11.4.5; PCI DSS 11.4.6
Log Source: Penetration test findings; NetFlow / network telemetry; Firewall logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-11T09:30:00Z pentest-mgmt FINDING: evt=SEGMENTATION_FAIL test_ref=PT-2026-014 method=port_scan_from_out_of_scope source_segment=CORP_WORKSTATIONS reachable_cde_hosts=3 reachable_services=1433/tcp,22/tcp,3389/tcp finding_severity=High remediation_due=2026-03-25 status=OPEN
Description: Segmentation controls must be tested at least every six months for service providers and confirmed operational. Open findings are tracked in the SIEM so the compensating monitoring stays in place until they close.

Use Case Name: Third-party service provider access anomaly
Control Reference: PCI DSS 12.8.2; PCI DSS 12.8.4; PCI DSS 8.2.7
Log Source: VPN / remote access logs; Privileged access management (PAM); Cloud control-plane logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-08T04:18:52Z pam-prd CYBERARK: evt=SESSION_ACTIVITY safe=TPSP_PAYMENTS account=tpsp_gateway_svc user=vendor_posmaint@partner.example target=cde-db-01 commands_executed=41 included="mysqldump --all-databases" contract_scope=POS_TERMINAL_SUPPORT scope_violation=true recording=ENABLED
Description: Monitors what third parties with CDE access actually do against the scope of their contracted service, and maintains the evidence Requirement 12.8 expects about TPSP responsibilities.

Use Case Name: Security incident not acknowledged or contained within the defined SLA
Control Reference: PCI DSS 12.10.1; PCI DSS 12.10.4; PCI DSS 12.10.5
Log Source: ITSM / ticketing; SIEM case management
Sample Log: 2026-03-07T07:00:00Z soar-prd CASE_SLA: evt=SLA_BREACH case=INC0044902 title="Malware on CDE host cde-app-07" severity=Critical created=2026-03-07T03:18:44Z ack_sla_min=15 ack_actual_min=222 containment_sla_min=60 containment_status=NOT_STARTED on_call_rota=PAYMENTS_SEC
Description: Requirement 12.10 requires a tested incident response plan with 24/7 coverage and defined alert handling. Measuring acknowledgement and containment against the plan turns it from a document into a control.

Use Case Name: Critical security control failure detected and reported
Control Reference: PCI DSS 10.7.2; PCI DSS 10.7.3; PCI DSS 12.10.5
Log Source: SIEM collector health; Anti-malware management console; Firewall logs; File integrity monitoring (FIM)
Sample Log: 2026-03-09T08:05:00Z soar-prd CONTROL_HEALTH: evt=CONTROL_FAILURE_SUMMARY window=24h failures=[{control:ANTI_MALWARE,asset:cde-db-01,state:NOT_REPORTING,hours:52},{control:FIM,asset:cde-web-03,state:AGENT_STOPPED,hours:19},{control:LOG_FORWARDING,asset:pos-ctrl-02,state:SILENT,hours:12}] pci_req=10.7.2 response_initiated=false
Description: Requirement 10.7.2 names the controls whose failure must be detected and responded to: firewalls, IDS/IPS, anti-malware, FIM, logging, segmentation, physical access and audit mechanisms. A single rolled-up control-health detection covers the requirement end to end.

Use Case Name: Card payment authorisation anomaly — testing and enumeration
Control Reference: PCI DSS 6.4.2; PCI DSS 11.5.1; PCI DSS 12.10.5
Log Source: Payment switch / authorisation logs; Load balancer / WAF logs
Sample Log: 2026-03-06T21:02:17Z authsw-01 ISO8583: mti=0100 pan_masked=453912******1881 amount=000000000100 currency=826 merchant_id=M00418821 terminal=ECOM resp_code=14 attempts_from_ip=1,942 window_min=12 distinct_pans=1,860 approval_rate=0.021 src_ip=45.133.1.77 flag=CARD_TESTING
Description: High-velocity low-value authorisations with a very low approval rate and many distinct PANs is card testing against the payment page — an early indicator that a stolen card file is being validated through the merchant's own channel.

Use Case Name: Cardholder data environment cloud storage exposed
Control Reference: PCI DSS 3.2.1; PCI DSS 1.4.4; PCI DSS 7.2.1
Log Source: Cloud control-plane logs; Cloud storage audit logs; CSPM findings
Sample Log: 2026-03-08T12:41:09Z cspm-prd WIZ: evt=PUBLIC_EXPOSURE resource=s3://pci-settlement-archive region=eu-west-1 change=BucketPolicy principal="*" actions=s3:GetObject made_public_by=arn:aws:iam::4411:user/svc_deploy at=2026-03-08T12:38:51Z objects=18,221 contains_chd=true encryption=AES256 public_access_block=DISABLED
Description: Object stores, snapshots and managed databases holding account data that become publicly reachable, lose their encryption setting, or are shared to an external account.

Use Case Name: Payment application error flood or authorisation failure spike
Control Reference: PCI DSS 10.2.1.5; PCI DSS 11.5.1; PCI DSS 12.10.5
Log Source: Application logs; Payment switch / authorisation logs; Monitoring platform
Sample Log: 2026-03-06T21:08:40Z cde-app-07 payment-api[7741]: level=ERROR event=auth_backend_failure count_1m=4,812 baseline_1m=22 error="HSM session rejected: key handle invalid" keyset=PRD_PAN_KEK_2025 fallback_mode=PLAINTEXT_CACHE_ENABLED operator_ack=false
Description: Error floods matter when the failure mode is insecure — a crypto backend outage that silently enables a plaintext fallback cache is both an availability event and a stored-account-data breach in progress.
